description: Implementation of 128-bit integer arithmetic and formatting functions for absl::uint128 and absl::int128, including division, conversion from floating point, and output stream operators.

classes.name: uint128
classes.description: Represents a 128-bit unsigned integer with arithmetic and formatting capabilities.

classes.name: int128
classes.description: Represents a 128-bit signed integer with arithmetic and formatting capabilities.

methods.name: operator/
methods.description: Performs division of uint128 and int128 types.

methods.name: operator%
methods.description: Performs modulo operation for uint128 and int128 types.

methods.name: operator<<
methods.description: Outputs uint128 and int128 values to streams with formatting.

methods.name: MakeUint128FromFloat
methods.description: Converts floating point values to uint128.

methods.name: MakeInt128FromFloat
methods.description: Converts floating point values to int128.
